XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS AI Course Recommendations — Phase H.0 (MVP) schema. One table: recommendations_log (one row per generated recommendation for a learner). Each row carries the model, the prompt version, the score Claude assigned, and the reasoning so a learner can ask 'why was this suggested?'.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_rec_log
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase H.0 (2026-05-25) — One row per generated course recommendation. A single 'batch' of N recommendations for a learner is keyed by batchid — used to display the most recent batch in the dashboard block and to invalidate stale recommendations.
'score' is a normalised 0..100 confidence score that Claude assigns to each suggestion (used to order them in the dashboard block — highest first).
'reasoning' is the short, one-sentence rationale Claude produced explaining why this course is a good next step for this learner — surfaced to the learner via a 'Why this?' link.
'customerid' + 'costcenterid' follow the standard Sentientia LMS multi-customer / multi-tenant scope convention.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — the learner the recommendation is for.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to course.id — the recommended course.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA). Derived from learner open_path at recommendation time.

FIELD.NAME: batchid
FIELD.COMMENT: Identifier shared by all rows produced from a single Claude call. Used to display the most recent batch + invalidate stale ones.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic model identifier used for the generation. Recorded for audit.

FIELD.NAME: prompt_version
FIELD.COMMENT: System-prompt revision tag (e.g. v1, v2-cohort). Allows safe A/B prompt-quality testing.

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: Confidence score 0..100 Claude assigned to this suggestion. Used for ordering.

FIELD.NAME: rank_order
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order within the batch (1, 2, 3, ...). Lower = more prominent.

FIELD.NAME: reasoning
FIELD.COMMENT: Short rationale Claude produced explaining why this course is the right next step for this learner.

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: mock | live — which client generated this row.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_in
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic input_tokens reported by API for cost tracking. Divided pro-rata across batch rows.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_out
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic output_tokens reported by API for cost tracking. Divided pro-rata across batch rows.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active | dismissed | enrolled | expired — lifecycle of the recommendation.

INDEX.NAME: idx_user_batch
INDEX.COMMENT: Block render path: load the latest batch for a learner

INDEX.NAME: idx_user_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Filter active vs dismissed/enrolled rows for a learner
